description: Android activity class 'LocationActivity' demonstrating location services, reverse geocoding, and GPS enablement prompts.

classes.name: LocationActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling location updates, reverse geocoding, and GPS enable prompts.

classes.name: ReverseGeocodingTask
classes.description: AsyncTask for performing reverse geocoding without blocking UI.

classes.name: EnableGpsDialogFragment
classes.description: DialogFragment prompting user to enable GPS.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, restores state, and sets up UI components and handlers.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Sets up location updates when activity resumes.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Checks if GPS is enabled; prompts user if not.

methods.name: enableLocationSettings
methods.description: Launches system settings to enable location services.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes location updates when activity stops.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures location providers based on user selection.

methods.name: requestUpdatesFromProvider
methods.description: Requests location updates from specified provider, shows message if unavailable.

methods.name: useFineProvider
methods.description: Handles UI callback to use only GPS provider.

methods.name: useCoarseFineProviders
methods.description: Handles UI callback to use both GPS and network providers.

methods.name: updateUILocation
methods.description: Updates UI with new location and triggers reverse geocoding if available.

methods.name: getBetterLocation
methods.description: Compares two locations to determine the better one based on recency and accuracy.

methods.name: isSameProvider
methods.description: Checks if two location providers are the same.
